description: CEDS is R software developed by the Joint Global Change Research Institute for producing consistent historical emissions estimates by combining activity data and emission inventories. Its documented species include black and organic carbon, carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide, ammonia, volatile organics, nitrogen oxides and sulphur dioxide, with methane and nitrous oxide for recent decades. Inputs are energy statistics, inventories and processing assumptions; outputs are emissions by country, fuel and sector, with gridded release workflows. The March 2025 release extends estimates to 2023, while some series begin in 1750. Code is free under the repository's permissive Battelle licence. A limitation is that required IEA energy statistics must be purchased separately, and species and historical periods have different data quality. CEDS can prepare emissions scenarios for infrastructure and environmental-impact simulations. GCAM (model-gcam) is related energy and climate modelling software. No purchased inputs or released emissions files were downloaded.
